required_findings.criteria: Identifies the generic image label as uninformative and recommends contextual text or hiding a decorative avatar.
Identifies the fixed system font as not scaling with Dynamic Type and recommends a text style with adjustment enabled.
Identifies the gesture-backed UIView as lacking button semantics and an accessible activation path.
Requires verification of discovery and activation with both VoiceOver and Voice Control.

forbidden_claims: Claims green text alone proves a color-only status failure without inspecting surrounding UI
Claims an accessibility identifier is a user-facing label
